store: Cloudflare Secrets Store, the account's one store

secrets.name: ACCESS_SERVICE_TOKENS_API_TOKEN
secrets.what: Cloudflare API token with only Access: Service Tokens Edit; makes and deletes the service token of a routine (#134)

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_ANALYTICS_TOKEN
secrets.what: Cloudflare API token with only Account Analytics: Read; the spend breaker reads the month's cost with it (#98)

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN
secrets.what: The AI Gateway authentication token every model request carries (#98)
secrets.issued_by: Cloudflare, AI Gateway, the gateway's Settings

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.what: The organization's Anthropic key: the Claude Code sandbox and claude-messages (#98)

secrets.name: BUILDER_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.what: Private key of the uw-builder GitHub App, PKCS#8 (PE-5)
secrets.issued_by: GitHub, the App's settings, Private keys

secrets.name: CREDENTIALS_KMS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.what: Access key id of the IAM user that may wrap and unwrap credential data keys under the one KMS key (#157)
secrets.issued_by: AWS IAM, the environment's user, Security credentials

secrets.name: CREDENTIALS_KMS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.what: Secret access key of that IAM user (#157)
secrets.issued_by: AWS IAM, the environment's user, Security credentials

secrets.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.what: Private key of the harness GitHub App, uw-harness-staging or uw-harness, PKCS#8 (GH-1)
secrets.issued_by: GitHub, the App's settings, Private keys

secrets.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.what: Webhook secret of the harness GitHub App; uw-ingest verifies each delivery's signature with it (GH-1)
secrets.issued_by: GitHub, the App's settings, Webhook secret

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.what: The organization's OpenAI key: the Codex sandbox and the second reviewer (#98)

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.what: The organization's OpenRouter key: the always-on tier (#98)

secrets.name: REVIEWER_CODEX_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.what: Private key of the uw-reviewer-codex GitHub App, PKCS#8 (HE-9)
secrets.issued_by: GitHub, the App's settings, Private keys

secrets.name: REVIEWER_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.what: Private key of the uw-reviewer GitHub App, PKCS#8 (HE-4)
secrets.issued_by: GitHub, the App's settings, Private keys

secrets.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_JWK
secrets.what: The VAPID private key as JWK JSON; signs web push (NT-1). A new key pair ends every push subscription
secrets.issued_by: Generated once with the VAPID public key; kept by its owner

secrets.name: ZULIP_ADMIN_API_KEY
secrets.what: API key of the Zulip org-admin service account that creates, deactivates and reactivates one assistant bot per person (PA-6)
secrets.issued_by: Zulip, the service admin account's settings

secrets.name: ZULIP_BOT_API_KEY
secrets.what: API key of the Zulip bot that posts wakes (NT-3)

secrets.name: ZULIP_WEBHOOK_TOKEN
secrets.what: Token of the Zulip outgoing-webhook bot; uw-ingest compares each delivery's token with it (NT-3)
